policy: Watchdog self-heals stale engines, records Qualified Best scheduled/actual monitor age, dispatches a fallback when the scheduled monitor is missing/stale even if deployment checks are recent (10-minute cooldown), retries failed board/deploy runs once per 20-minute cooldown, and dispatches isolated eFootball winner/GG-NG research when its market archive or collector capture is over 30 minutes stale (15-minute cooldown). The eFootball research workflow is shadow-only and never gates Qualified Best or Odds Builder. Stale Virtual Lab participant/settlement/model artifacts and NBA totals settlement ledgers trigger bounded recovery even when queued/in-progress runs are stuck. The NBA ledger recovers after 30 minutes of stale publication, cancelling queued runs after 10 minutes or jobs after 15 minutes; Virtual Lab collector runs cancel queued runs after 10 minutes or jobs after 25 minutes. Stale Virtual Lab participant/settlement/model artifacts trigger collector recovery even when a queued/in-progress run is stuck (cancel queued runs after 10 minutes or running jobs after 25 minutes); live snapshots and NBA in-game observation heartbeats trigger bounded fallback dispatches. Successful NBA recorder and Odds Builder completions provide an event-driven watchdog heartbeat when cron delivery stalls. Workflow_run checks do not rewrite feed data to avoid downstream loops. Health publication is retried across concurrent data writers.
